notes: General Fund portion of the 2023 Local Expenditure Program. Printed pages present: "Page 1 of 152 pages" to "Page 4 of 152 pages" (Receipts Program) and "Page 135 of 152" to "Page 152 of 152 pages", plus the General Fund Statement of Indebtedness ("Page 1 of 1 Page"). Printed pages 5 to 134 (the per-office expenditure programs) are not in the PDF.

PDF page 1 is the cover ("Local Expenditure Program, January 1 to December 31, 2023"); PDF pages 6 to 11 (printed pages 135 to 140) are the narrative General Provisions of the appropriation ordinance and its signature page (certified by SP/City Secretary Francisco Y. Limpangug, attested by Vice-Mayor Celedonio B. Sitoy, approved by City Mayor Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan). They were not transcribed.

UNITS: the Receipts Program header says "(In 000 Pesos)", but the figures are in full pesos, not thousands: e.g. the 2023 National Tax Allotment is printed 1,445,271,518.00 and Total General Fund Receipts 2,871,781,518.00, which equal the appropriation totals in the other schedules (TOTAL by office 2,871,781,518.00) and the approved P2,871,781,518.00 General Fund budget in the ordinance. Values are transcribed as printed, in pesos, not multiplied by 1,000.

This document is not an LBP Form 2 per-office report. summary.offices is taken from schedule "2. Proposed New Appropriations, by Office" (budget year 2023). The schedule prints no per-office subtotals: lettered offices (A to AU) and the indented programs/units listed under them are separate rows, so an indented row carries "parent" (the lettered office it is printed under) and is not included in the lettered office's own figures. The Local Disaster Risk Reduction Management Fund row (under A. Office of the City Mayor) has a Lump-Sum Appropriation of 43,076,723.00 and is listed in summary.specialPurposeAppropriations instead of summary.offices.
The by-office schedule repeats "A. Office of the City Mayor" and "AK. Office of the Police Services" as continuation headings at the top of the next page; kept as header rows.

Faint marks at the right edge of the Receipts Program budget-year column (Occupation Fees, Miscellaneous Income, Tax Revenue-Fines and Penalties - Other Taxes) look like scan specks rather than printed dashes; those cells are transcribed as blank (null).

Cross-check: the by-office class totals reconcile with the by-object schedule: PS 870,149,483.00 = Total Personal Services 859,389,483.00 + special-purpose PS 10,760,000.00; MOOE 1,591,868,008.00 = 957,602,088.00 + special-purpose MOOE (361,312,713.00 + hospital subsidy 200,990,597.00 + debt service 730,257.00 + aid to barangays 20,720,000.00 + LDRRM 50,512,353.00); Capital Outlay 366,687,304.00 = 21,605,000.00 + 6,028,000.00 + LDRRM 50,000,000.00 + development projects 289,054,304.00; Lump-Sum 43,076,723.00 = 30% Quick Response Fund. In the by-object schedule, Debt Services (Loan Payable 710,257.00, Interest Payment 20,000.00) is printed under a "Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses" sub-heading.
Statement of Indebtedness: the National Housing Authority (2008) loan's Balance of the Principal is printed "-" (0). "Land Bank of the Philippines" is printed as a heading row with no figures.
